job_description: Lockheed Martin, a leader in advancing cutting-edge technology systems, seeks a knowledgeable and skilled Senior Software Engineer. This role demands a strong commitment to ethics, inclusivity, and teamwork in developing sophisticated software solutions that meet or exceed the demanding standards of military, aerospace, and defense applications. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the creation and implementation of critical software components used in various defense systems, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure robust, secure, and effective applications.
